mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories ( parent_id, name, image_url, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{parent_id}, #{name}, #{image_url}, IFNULL(#{sort_order}, 0) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, name, image_url, sort_order, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM categories WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order ASC, name ASC
